from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,datetime,collections
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence/story-6-4';out=base/'qualification-20261017-parent'
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
index=json.loads((base/'qualification-20261017-gates.json').read_text());frames=[]
for e in index['gates']:
 if e['name'] not in ['server-debug-focused','server-debug-full','server-release-full']:continue
 p=base/e['packet'];d=json.loads(p.read_text());lp=root/d['log']['path'];assert ident(lp)==d['log']
 rows=[];retry=[];counts=collections.Counter()
 for line in lp.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
  m=re.search(r'\[OUTPUT\] (\w+) (\{.*\})$',line)
  if not m:continue
  try:v=json.loads(m[2])
  except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
  kind=m[1];counts[kind]+=1
  if kind in ['ProjectionProofWorkingRoots','ProjectionProofReadbackWorkingRoots']:
   ceiling=4*(16384+80*v['head']+512*min(v['head'],v['receiptLimit']));assert v['ceiling']==ceiling
   keys=['retainedRootBytes','validationRootBytes','serializerRootBytes','transportRootBytes'] if kind=='ProjectionProofWorkingRoots' else ['readbackRootBytes']
   assert all(v[k]<=ceiling for k in keys)
   if 'serialized' in v:assert v['serialized']<=min(4194304,ceiling//4)
   rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'bound':ceiling,'interpretation':'Separate measured retained phases; no sum of mutually exclusive phases or generic peak-live claim.'})
  elif kind in ['ProjectionSourceDecodeWorkingRoots','ProjectionEventWorkingRoots']:
   assert v['ceiling']==69206016
   keys=['actorDecodeRootBytes','stateDecodeRootBytes','providerRootBytes'] if kind=='ProjectionSourceDecodeWorkingRoots' else ['providerRootBytes','sourceRootBytes','writerRootBytes']
   assert all(v[k]<=69206016 for k in keys);rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'bound':69206016,'interpretation':'Concrete stated owning managed roots by phase, preserving native coverage limits.'})
  elif kind=='ProjectionGuardReceiptRetainedGraph':
   assert v['retainedTypedProofBytes']<=v['proofWorkingByteLimit'];assert v['cumulativeAllocationsMeasured'] is False
   rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'interpretation':'Retained typed graph; not cumulative allocation.'})
  elif kind=='ProjectionGuardReceiptFlood':
   assert v['retainedTypedReceiptGraphBytes']==0 and v['retainedExceptionBytes']<=v['proofWorkingByteLimit'];assert v['peakLiveBytesMeasured'] is False
   rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'interpretation':'Early rejection and retained exception; cumulative allocations do not establish peak live.'})
  elif kind in ['ProjectionGuardWideCumulativeAllocation','ProjectionGuardDepthAllocation']:
   assert v.get('cumulativeAllocatedBytes',v.get('allocatedBytes'))<=v['regressionBound']
   rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'interpretation':'Cumulative-allocation regression assertion only.'})
  elif kind=='ProjectionGuardActualDepthAllocation':
   assert v['allocatedBytes']<=v['proofWorkingByteLimit'] and v['owningAllocatedBytes']<=v['proofWorkingByteLimit']
   rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'interpretation':'Measured cumulative allocations, not peak-live/retained proof.'})
  elif kind=='ProjectionGuardMalformedDigestCumulativeAllocation':
   assert v['peakLiveBytesMeasured'] is False;rows.append({'kind':kind,'observed':v,'interpretation':'Cumulative early-rejection allocation; native assertion owns its regression bound.'})
  elif kind=='ProjectionActualGuardRetryCosts':
   assert v['activations']==9 and v['saturatedAttempt']==8 and len(v['measurements'])==9
   ms=v['measurements'];assert set(ms[0])==set(v['firstEight'])==set(v['firstNine'])
   assert all(sum(x[k] for x in ms[:8])==v['firstEight'][k] and sum(x[k] for x in ms)==v['firstNine'][k] for k in ms[0])
   n=v['head']-v['checkpoint'];q=(n+v['pageSize']-1)//v['pageSize']
   for cost in ms:
    assert cost['SourceInspections']<=3 and cost['SourceRanges']<=3*q and cost['SourceReturnedEvents']<=3*n
    assert cost['Activations']==1 and cost['RetryActivations']==1
    assert all(cost[k]==0 for k in ['HandlerAttempts','BatchExecutions','ModelMutations'])
   retry.append({'activations':9,'saturatedAttempt':8,'separatePerActivationBoundsPassed':True,'firstEightAndFirstNineExactlySumNativeMeasurements':True,'firstEightSourceRanges':v['firstEight']['SourceRanges'],'firstNineSourceRanges':v['firstNine']['SourceRanges'],'interpretation':'Native controlled ambiguous-proof retry fixture, no extrapolation to lifetime success.'})
 frames.append({'gate':d['name'],'packet':ident(p),'nativeLog':ident(lp),'observationCounts':dict(counts),'workingRootAndAllocationRows':rows,'actualRetryWindows':retry})
result={'auditedUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Independent parent extraction from completed native logs only; assertions distinguish retained roots, cumulative allocation and N8/N9 accounting. Native cohorts retain their own outcome.','frames':frames,'auditCommand':['python3','/tmp/story64_parent_working_roots_audit.py'],'auditScriptSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'auditScript':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(out/'working-roots-and-retry-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([{'gate':f['gate'],'memoryRows':len(f['workingRootAndAllocationRows']),'actualRetryWindows':len(f['actualRetryWindows'])} for f in frames],indent=2))
